events.title: European Shares Seen Higher As Yields Tick Down
events.description: European stocks are seen opening higher on Friday despite overnight losses on Wall Street. U.S. stock futures ticked higher after the Nasdaq posted its biggest single-day loss since mid-August on fresh concerns over the sustainability of the AI spending boom.

events.title: Indian Shares Rally After Trump's Remarks About Iran; IT Stocks Lead
events.description: Indian shares were notably higher in early trade on Friday after U.S. President Donald Trump ruled out attacking Iran before the U.S. midterm elections on November 3, asserting that record volumes of crude were currently passing through the Strait of Hormuz.

events.title: Australian Market Extends Early Gains In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is extending its early gains in mid-market moves on Friday, snapping a four-session losing streak, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is moving above the 8,700 level, with gains in energy and financial stocks partially offset by weakness in mining and technology stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Trade Mixed
events.description: Asian markets are mixed on Friday, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight, on renewed spike in crude oil prices amid ongoing attacks on tankers in the Middle East and concerns about hurricane-related production disruption in the Gulf of Mexico. Reports suggest that US President Donald Trump and his national security team have discussed resuming large-scale military operations in Iran.

events.title: Indian Shares Seeking Rebound With IT Stocks In Focus
events.description: Indian shares are seen opening higher on Friday despite overnight losses on Wall Street. Information technology stocks would be in the spotlight today after TCS delivered a 15 percent year-on-year increase in Q2 consolidated net profit and the Nasdaq posted its biggest single-day loss since mid-August on fresh concerns over the sustainability of the AI spending boom.

events.title: Japanese Market Significantly Lower
events.description: The Japanese market is trading significantly lower on Friday, extending the losses in the previous two sessions, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight. The Nikkei 225 is falling below the 68,300 level, with weakness in index heavyweights, technology and financial stocks.

events.title: Australian Market Notably Higher
events.description: The Australian stock market is trading notably higher on Friday, snapping a four-session losing streak, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is moving up to near the 8,700 level, with gains in energy and financial stocks partially offset by weakness in mining and technology stocks.

events.title: TSX Modestly Higher As Energy Stocks Rise
events.description:
The Canadian market is modestly higher Thursday afternoon with stocks from energy and consumer staples sectors posting strong gains. Technology stocks are weak.

Higher oil prices and bond yields amid an escalation in Middle East tensions rendered the mood cautious at the start. However, stocks found some support subsequently and the market moved above the flat line.

events.title: Swiss Stocks Fall As Oil's Rise Triggers Inflation Worries
events.description: Swiss stocks ended notably lower on Thursday after languishing in negative territory throughout the day's trading session, as higher oil prices and bond yields raised inflation and interest rate concerns.

events.title: European Stocks Settle Weak As Oil's Surge Fuels On Inflation, Rate Worries
events.description: European stocks closed weak on Thursday, with several markets dropping to multi-month lows, as concerns about inflation and interest rates amid rising oil prices and bond yields hurt sentiment.

events.title: U.S. Jobless Claims Unexpectedly Dip From Upwardly Revised Level
events.description: The Labor Department released a report on Thursday showing first-time claims for U.S. unemployment benefits unexpectedly dipped from an upwardly revised level in the week ended October 3rd. The report said initial jobless claims edged down to 197,000, a decrease of 2,000 from the previous week's revised level of 199,000.

events.title: Canadian Stocks Poised For Weak Open As Oil Surges On Iran Tensions
events.description: Canadian shares face weakness Thursday as Middle East escalation concerns drive oil prices higher. West Texas Intermediate crude jumped 4.8% to $92.52 per barrel amid U.S.-Iran conflict reports. Gold and silver futures show mixed movement.

events.title: U.S. Weekly Jobless Claims Unexpectedly Dip To 197,000
events.description: The Labor Department released a report on Thursday showing first-time claims for U.S. unemployment benefits unexpectedly dipped from an upwardly revised level in the week ended October 3rd.
